issues.claim: in .NET 10 the built-in generation produces an OpenAPI 3.1 document by default
issues.problem: The claim is true for .NET 10 (Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi defaults to OpenAPI 3.1; .NET 9 produced 3.0). The fetched overview excerpt does not show it, though it does confirm net10.0, AddOpenApi/MapOpenApi and Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server. The cited links therefore do not directly back this sentence. The OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec paraphrase ('language-agnostic ... without access to source code') matches the spec intro.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add the 'Generate OpenAPI documents' page or the .NET 10 breaking-changes page as a link, or soften to 'in .NET 10 the default output version is OpenAPI 3.1'. Mirror the change in the ru explanation.

issues.claim: `AddStandardResilienceHandler` ... the call to the external dependency uses the standard handler with options tuned to the budget
issues.problem: Item 6 tells the reader to respect Retry-After, but item 7 does not say how the standard handler does it. The fetched excerpt shows the defaults (3 retries, exponential backoff, jitter, 30s total) and says nothing about Retry-After. I believe HttpRetryStrategyOptions.ShouldRetryAfterHeader is false by default, so a reader may assume the standard handler already honours Retry-After when it does not. This cannot be confirmed from the excerpts.
issues.suggestedFix: Verify ShouldRetryAfterHeader and its default in the Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience API reference. Then state explicitly in item 7 that Retry-After is honoured only when `options.Retry.ShouldRetryAfterHeader = true` is set (if the default is false), in both ru and en.

issues.claim: Сколько вызовов к D может породить один запрос к A, если каждое звено повторяет независимо
issues.problem: The hint points straight at the multiplication, which is one of the core points of the answer. It is still a nudge and the rest of the plan is not revealed, so it is acceptable, but it is close to giving the answer away.
issues.suggestedFix: Soften to: 'Что происходит с числом обращений к D, когда retry настроен независимо на каждом звене, и в какой момент эти повторы срабатывают?' (EN: 'What happens to the number of calls reaching D when every hop has its own independent retry, and when do those retries fire?')
